Data analytics · Campaign attribution

Analytics Incident Lab

I built a browser lab that shows how the same drop in reported campaign visits can point to two different problems.

Independent project

The problem

Reports can show fewer campaign visits when people stop arriving or when links lose a tracking ID. Both fictional cases start with attributed visits falling from 170 to 106, a drop of 37.6%.

What the evidence showed

In Fieldnote, landing page visits stayed at 170 and orders stayed at 21. The updated email link lacked its campaign ID. The report keeps the 64 sessions with missing IDs under unknown attribution. In Grove, landing page visits fell to 106 and orders fell to 14. The campaign links kept their IDs.

How I built it

The demo and the two skills for Codex and Claude Code use the same calculation code. One skill investigates a drop in a metric. The other checks campaign attribution. The data-agent-evals kit checks whether answers match known results, including cases with ambiguous IDs or missing data.

What you can try

Run both cases, replay a campaign link, and download the source files and your findings. The demo runs in the browser without an account or API key.
